dct_title_s: Carta Ferroviaria fisico-politica del Regno d'Italia
dct_description_sm: Dated from condition of Agrigento-Naro-Licata railroad, Sicily.
Handwritten title: "YMCA Work in Italy" with lists under headings "At the Front" and "In the Cities" and legend of services, locations to be developed, and work (dated May 1918).
